title: HILLARY CLINTON AT SUFFS @@PBS GREAT PREFORMANCES PREMIERE 💜😱🗳️ #suff...
transcript: Because at a moment when our rights, um, our civil rights, uh, women's rights, voting rights, human rights, the very foundation of our democracy are imperiled, it is easy sometimes to feel discouraged. And we see that, you know, the subs met all kinds of pushback and contempt and disdain. Uh, they didn't have it easy at all. Uh, we see their setbacks, their exhaustion. Uh, the moments when maybe it doesn't matter that they have to go through so much, but then they keep each other going. So I'm not gonna spoil the ending, but, yes, we did get the 19th Amendment. But you know what? That was not the end of the fight. Um, because it was on paper, it was in the Constitution, but it did not apply to all women. Uh, it took, uh, years more to guarantee the rights of Native American women, of black women, of women of color, of all kinds. And so we have to remember that, uh, we inherit, uh, their sacrifice. We inherit that responsibility, and we have to carry that, and we have to pass it on. Uh, because you know the great line, uh, in keep marching? Progress is possible but not guaranteed. The only way we can make progress is that each and every one of us decide to be part of making that progress.
classificationReason: Captures Hillary Clinton speaking at the PBS Great Performances premiere event for Suffs. Commentary/event coverage about the show, not a first-hand review of the stage production by the creator.
